description: A volunteer experience entry in the user's professional profile.

main.description: Record representing a single volunteer role.

organizationDid.description: DID of the organization's ATproto account, if one exists.

entityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the organization the user selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...), a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Enables deterministic resolution to a canonical entity even before the organization claims an ATproto account. Absent for free-text entries.

description.description: Description of volunteer activities and impact.

startedAt.description: Start date of the volunteer role.

endedAt.description: End date. Omit if currently volunteering.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.
